policies.name: normal_walk/3_normal_walk
policies.note: Normal walk (Start) — gait-clock walker, speed level Up (1.5 m/s) / Down (0.8 m/s)

policies.name: sport_mode/4_sport_mode
policies.note: Sport mode (L2+Start) — fast trot (3.5 m/s × stick), net stepped twice per tick

policies.name: climb_mode/5_climb_mode
policies.note: Climb mode (R1+X) — stair / obstacle walker (raised front legs), stepped twice per tick

policies.name: sided_gait/6_left_side_gait
policies.note: Left side gait (X X) — one sided_gait net, roll command −0.4; Start = back to walking

policies.name: sided_gait/7_right_side_gait
policies.note: Right side gait (Y Y) — one sided_gait net, roll command +0.4; Start = back to walking

policies.name: sided_gait/8_handstand
policies.note: Hand stand (R1 R1) — one sided_gait net, pitch command +1.2 (front legs); Start = back to walking

policies.name: sided_gait/9_biped_stand
policies.note: Biped stand (R2 R2) — one sided_gait net, pitch command −1.2 (hind legs); Start = back to walking

policies.name: flip/10_front_flip
policies.note: Front flip (Up Up) — 1.43 s phase-driven forward flip, then normal walk

policies.name: flip/11_back_flip
policies.note: Back flip (Down Down) — 1.43 s phase-driven back flip, then normal walk

policies.name: recovery/12_recovery
policies.note: Recovery (L2+X) — relax → fold (leg IK) → recovery net → normal walk; starts on the back

policies.name: base_height/13_base_height
policies.note: Base height (L1+Up / L1+Down) — walker with a body-height command, L1+Up / L1+Down ±0.005 m per tick

policies.name: euler/15_euler
policies.note: Euler (body pose) (Select) — stands still; sticks = roll / pitch / yaw body pose
